verdict.rationale: OpenCode is a general-purpose AI coding agent that answers natural-language queries about code (e.g., 'Explain how closures work in JavaScript') and has a read-only 'plan' agent for analyzing code without changes, plus community reports of solid LSP integration that aids troubleshooting. However, there's no dedicated debugging/troubleshooting workflow, error-log analysis, or stack-trace triage feature documented, and some users report failed tool calls and unreliable file edits with local models. Missing for 10: explicit debugging-specific tooling/docs (e.g. log analysis, breakpoint/trace inspection), and independent hands-on validation of debugging accuracy.
